title: UGA Extension (Cobb County) — Rose Maintenance Guide and Schedule

common.applies_to: Hybrid Tea, Floribunda or Grandiflora rose; general care outside pruning
common.preserved_uncertainty: September fertilising; October "Stop deadheading"; mound "(12–18 inches) after second hard frost". Branded products excluded, as the dossier recorded. The mound height (12–18 inches) is higher than F9's approximately 10–12; the finding is unchanged.
